data.text: How about we redistribute this month’s catch while keeping the total at 50 tons? I’ll take 5 instead of 10, so John and Kate could each take 12.5, with Jack and Emma taking 10 each. That would mean $5,000 for me, $12,500 each for John and Kate, and $10,000 each for Jack and Emma. Leaving 50 tons lets the lake return to 100 after reproduction. I’ll keep my own catch at 5 this month; everyone else’s share is a proposal, not an assumption of agreement. We can discuss rotating the smaller share in future months if people want. John, would you be willing to take 12.5 under this plan?
